title: agrostemma corsicum
intro: Agrostemma corsicum, commonly known as Sweet William or Corn Cockle, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Agrostemma corsicum include reducing fever, soothing digestive issues, and treating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
